business_problem: To continue scaling up, it needed to rapidly grow within the cloud and develop a resilient competitive platform to process payments.
solution_summary: ClearBank built its Microsoft solution to improve cloud migration and platform modernization. To continue scaling up, it needed to rapidly grow within the cloud and develop a resilient competitive platform to process payments. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Azure Databricks ran model inference or heavy processing. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Microsoft Fabric delivers governed insights to teams across ClearBank. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Unifies data engineering, analytics, and business-intelligence workloads on one cloud platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale datasets and runs analytics or model-processing jobs.

solution_components.name: Azure HDInsight
solution_components.role: Runs large-scale distributed data-processing workloads for the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Operates containerized application and AI workloads in a managed Kubernetes environment.

solution_components.name: Azure DevOps
solution_components.role: Supports deployment, testing, and release management for the Microsoft solution estate.

solution_components.name: Azure App Service
solution_components.role: Hosts customer-facing or internal web applications on managed Azure infrastructure.

business_outcome: "We've maintained five times more uptime than last year and 100 percent uptime this year, which we wouldn't have been able to do if we had just been running in a single zone without the architecture we've created alongside Microsoft" Tom Harris, Chief Technology Officer, ClearBank A clear vision for growth with Azure As the newest clearing bank in the United Kingdom in 250 years, ClearBank helps financial technology companies quickly and easily access cutting-edge financial products and services like agency banking and embedded banking.
metrics: "We've maintained five times more uptime than last year and 100 percent uptime this year, which we wouldn't have been able to do if we had just been running in a single zone without the architecture we've created alongside Microsoft" Tom Harris, Chief Technology Officer, ClearBank A clear vision for growth with Azure As the newest clearing bank in the United Kingdom in 250 years, ClearBank helps financial technology companies quickly and easily access cutting-edge financial products and services like agency banking and embedded banking.

Since receiving its banking license in 2017, ClearBank has ramped up volume and expanded its team from 100 to 800 employees supporting the firm's rapid growth, including the more than 600 releases pushed to its system every month during working hours.
"In 2018, we struggled to process 8,000 payments a month, and now we handle about 20 million payments a month," says Tom Harris, Chief Technology Officer at ClearBank.

"We aim for around 30 minutes from discovery of an incident to recovery, and we can largely achieve that goal using Application Insights to get immediate alerting prompts from our systems and diagnose them accurately and quickly," says Harris.
As a result, the firm processes 99% of all payments within its service level objectives, including processing Faster Payments transactions in less than 10 seconds.
architecture_clues: To continue scaling up, it needed to rapidly grow within the cloud and develop a resilient competitive platform to process payments.
Overcoming regulatory concerns about cloud security, ClearBank moved its services to Microsoft Azure Service Fabric and App Service Environment.
It added other Azure products and Microsoft Security solutions to help protect and enhance the platform.

It's regularly rolling out more banking services and transactional solutions, including wealth management products, on its platform to augment a competitive operating model built using new technologies and an API-first approach.
